start.speaker: Order of the day
start.text: Order of the day, unsigned: the gate holds until the light returns. No provision was made for the light not returning.

forgotten_castle_2.speaker: Scratched inside a helm
forgotten_castle_2.text: Forty-one at muster. Thirty at supper. The Serjeant went on calling the whole roll, and the room went on being quiet in the same eleven places.

forgotten_castle_3.speaker: Guardroom tally
forgotten_castle_3.text: The tally stops at eleven hundred. Below it, in another hand: we stopped counting days and started counting lamps.

forgotten_castle_4.speaker: Notice at the sallyport
forgotten_castle_4.text: Nobody descends. Countersigned by three officers. All three signatures are below the door.

forgotten_castle_5.speaker: Quartermaster's slate
forgotten_castle_5.text: Lamp oil: none. Candles: none. Requisition submitted the day the shaft was opened. Countersigned, unfilled, still pinned up.

forgotten_castle_6.speaker: Letter, undelivered
forgotten_castle_6.text: You will have heard by now that the light is being kept safe. Please tell mother it is being kept safe.

forgotten_castle_7.speaker: Chalked on the muster wall
forgotten_castle_7.text: Names below this line reported to the Chapter. Do not strike them. They are coming back up.

forgotten_castle_8.speaker: Cut into a bench in the guardroom
forgotten_castle_8.text: Eleven years of watches. Nine hundred bells. One order, and it was the first one.

forgotten_castle_9.speaker: Physician's day-book
forgotten_castle_9.text: Treated: exhaustion, exhaustion, exhaustion. There is nothing in the book for what is actually wrong with them.

forgotten_castle_10.speaker: A child's hand, low on the wall
forgotten_castle_10.text: The stair goes down and the light goes down and I am not allowed to.

forgotten_castle_11.speaker: Order of the day, later
forgotten_castle_11.text: The gate holds. Nobody is to ask what it is holding against. Signed in a hand that shakes.

forgotten_castle_12.speaker: Scratched under the sallyport hinge
forgotten_castle_12.text: We opened it once for the Chapter. It has been ours to hold ever since, and it was never ours.

forgotten_castle_reread.speaker: Scratched under the sallyport hinge
forgotten_castle_reread.text: We opened it once for the Chapter. It has been ours to hold ever since, and it was never ours.

iron_vault_1.speaker: Requisition ledger
iron_vault_1.text: Received: one measure of daylight, sealed. Issued: nothing. Balance carried forward, and carried forward, and carried forward.

iron_vault_2.speaker: Clerk's marginal note
iron_vault_2.text: The Chapter says the light is stored, not spent. I have audited both columns. They are the same column.

iron_vault_3.speaker: Crate stamp
iron_vault_3.text: PROPERTY OF THE KEEPING, in fresh paint. Under it, where the paint is thin: PROPERTY OF THE CITY.

iron_vault_4.speaker: The long aisle
iron_vault_4.text: The vault door was barred from the inside. So is everything else in here, including the people who did the barring.

iron_vault_5.speaker: Inventory tag
iron_vault_5.text: Contents: one measure. Condition: sealed. Reweighed annually. The weight has never once been the same.

iron_vault_6.speaker: Conclave minute
iron_vault_6.text: Motion carried. The vault is to be sealed from within, the quorum remaining inside, until the account balances.

iron_vault_7.speaker: Stamped on a crate lid
iron_vault_7.text: Not for issue. Not for inspection. Not for the Chapter. Struck through, all three, in the same ink.

iron_vault_8.speaker: Vault keeper's note
iron_vault_8.text: I have counted the cells eleven times. There are eleven fewer than the ledger says and the ledger is in my hand.

iron_vault_9.speaker: Wax seal, broken and re-poured
iron_vault_9.text: Reseal authorised. Reason for opening: not recorded. Reason for resealing: not recorded.

iron_vault_10.speaker: Scratched inside a cell door
iron_vault_10.text: It was warm when they put it in. I checked it every winter. It has not been warm for nine.

iron_vault_11.speaker: Requisition, refused
iron_vault_11.text: Application to withdraw one measure for the town above. Refused. Grounds: the store is not for spending.

iron_vault_12.speaker: Last entry in the day ledger
iron_vault_12.text: Balance carried forward. There is no page after this one. Somebody removed the page after this one.

iron_vault_reread.speaker: Last entry in the day ledger
iron_vault_reread.text: Balance carried forward. There is no page after this one. Somebody removed the page after this one.

crystal_caverns_1.speaker: Survey mark
crystal_caverns_1.text: The seam runs true for nine miles and holds a light nobody remembers giving it.

crystal_caverns_2.speaker: Cutter's complaint, filed
crystal_caverns_2.text: The stone takes the shine out of the lamp and gives back a shine that does not warm. Filed. No reply recorded.

crystal_caverns_3.speaker: Gallery wall
crystal_caverns_3.text: Names scratched deep and then grown over. The stone did not object to being written on. It objected later.

crystal_caverns_4.speaker: Chapter directive
crystal_caverns_4.text: Every facet cut is a measure kept. Nobody asked what the measure was being kept from.

crystal_caverns_5.speaker: Surveyor's peg tag
crystal_caverns_5.text: Seam runs true to the shaft. Recommend no cutting. Recommendation acknowledged and overruled.

crystal_caverns_6.speaker: Chalk on a cut face
crystal_caverns_6.text: Clear when we found it. It took the colour off something. Nobody will say off what.

crystal_caverns_7.speaker: Cutter's tally
crystal_caverns_7.text: Four faces opened. Three men to a face. The count of faces is the only count anybody kept.

crystal_caverns_8.speaker: Note pinned to a lamp bracket
crystal_caverns_8.text: Do not bring a light past the second gallery. The galleries have started keeping them.

crystal_caverns_9.speaker: Scratched beside a socket in the rock
crystal_caverns_9.text: Something was set here and taken out again. The hole is the shape of a lantern and warm.

crystal_caverns_10.speaker: Foreman's complaint
crystal_caverns_10.text: The Chapter's men come down with empty glass and go up with full glass and we are told not to look at the glass.

crystal_caverns_11.speaker: Carved above a collapsed gallery
crystal_caverns_11.text: Nine behind this. We were told they would be relit. We were told this by a man holding a list.

crystal_caverns_12.speaker: Cut small, near the floor
crystal_caverns_12.text: The stone remembers being bright. That is all it remembers, and it will not stop.

crystal_caverns_reread.speaker: Cut small, near the floor
crystal_caverns_reread.text: The stone remembers being bright. That is all it remembers, and it will not stop.

prism_depths_1.speaker: The Lampwright's paper
prism_depths_1.text: Cut it thin enough and one lamp lights a city. Cut it thinner and it lights nothing at all, very brightly.

prism_depths_2.speaker: Choir rota
prism_depths_2.text: The choir here was tuned to the angle of the light, not to any key. When the angle moved they kept singing, which is the part that is hard to hear about.

prism_depths_3.speaker: Schedule of refractions
prism_depths_3.text: A careful hand, ending mid-column. The last entry is a fraction with no numerator.

prism_depths_4.speaker: Painted above the shaft
prism_depths_4.text: LIGHT ENTERS HERE. Nothing is painted anywhere to say where it leaves.

prism_depths_5.speaker: Chapter working note
prism_depths_5.text: Light admits of division. Divided light may be stored. Stored light may be returned. Each sentence was true when written.

prism_depths_6.speaker: Ledger of the store
prism_depths_6.text: Received, in trust, from the town of Aumbrye: their evening. To be returned entire.

prism_depths_7.speaker: Instrument label
prism_depths_7.text: Angle of incidence to be held at the mark. Off the mark the measure runs out and cannot be recovered.

prism_depths_8.speaker: Scratched on a cell frame
prism_depths_8.text: They asked for volunteers and then they stopped asking.

prism_depths_9.speaker: Cantor's margin note
prism_depths_9.text: The liturgy is longer than the process. That is deliberate. It is easier to repeat than a reason.

prism_depths_10.speaker: Struck through, still legible
prism_depths_10.text: The store is not full. The store has never been full. We have been issuing against a balance that does not exist.

prism_depths_11.speaker: A list, in a careful hand
prism_depths_11.text: Order of relighting. Names, with a mark against each. The marks are not ticks.

prism_depths_12.speaker: On the underside of a bench
prism_depths_12.text: I signed for it. I signed for all of it. My name is on every page and I did not read one.

prism_depths_reread.speaker: On the underside of a bench
prism_depths_reread.text: I signed for it. I signed for all of it. My name is on every page and I did not read one.

poison_swamp_1.speaker: Drainage order
poison_swamp_1.text: What the Vault cannot hold, send south. The south is where the water goes, and the water does not come back.

poison_swamp_2.speaker: Physician's note
poison_swamp_2.text: The fen is not poisoned. The fen is full. There is a difference, and it stopped mattering in the third year.

poison_swamp_3.speaker: Marker post, half sunk
poison_swamp_3.text: THE CITY — FOUR MILES. There is no road and there is no city, but the post is honest about the distance.

poison_swamp_4.speaker: Boat transom, upside down in the mud
poison_swamp_4.text: We carried it out and we carried it out, and it was always the same weight going back.

poison_swamp_5.speaker: Waterman's mark on a post
poison_swamp_5.text: Level rising. Level rising. Level rising. Four years of the same three words.

poison_swamp_6.speaker: Physician's note
poison_swamp_6.text: The water is not sick. Something upstream is being filtered and this is what comes through.

poison_swamp_7.speaker: Board nailed to a drowned door
poison_swamp_7.text: House of the Fen family. Six within. Do not open, the water is holding them still.

poison_swamp_8.speaker: Ferryman's tally
poison_swamp_8.text: Down: forty-one. Up: none. Fare unpaid, both directions, by agreement.

poison_swamp_9.speaker: Cut into a boat rib
poison_swamp_9.text: The low road out of the castle comes out here. Everything that came down it came up wrong.

poison_swamp_10.speaker: Fen-wife's receipt
poison_swamp_10.text: One remedy against the rot. Payment: whatever you have. It will not be enough and take it anyway.

poison_swamp_11.speaker: Scratched on a sluice gate
poison_swamp_11.text: Opened by order of the Chapter to drain the overflow. There is no record of what was overflowing.

poison_swamp_12.speaker: Half sunk, still readable
poison_swamp_12.text: We were told the mire was natural. The mire is eleven years old and so is my daughter.

poison_swamp_reread.speaker: Half sunk, still readable
poison_swamp_reread.text: We were told the mire was natural. The mire is eleven years old and so is my daughter.

venom_mire_1.speaker: Later drainage order
venom_mire_1.text: Same seal, shakier hand: send it further south. There is no further south. The order was carried out anyway.

venom_mire_2.speaker: The reeds
venom_mire_2.text: The procession walked in single file with a censer each. The reeds still lean the way they went.

venom_mire_3.speaker: Widow's petition
venom_mire_3.text: My husband was assigned to the overflow. I ask only which measure he became.

venom_mire_4.speaker: Chapter reply, drafted, never sent
venom_mire_4.text: The Keeping does not itemise persons. It itemises measures.

venom_mire_5.speaker: Marker post
venom_mire_5.text: Beyond this the water drains inward. That is not how water behaves.

venom_mire_6.speaker: Cull tally, kept in charcoal
venom_mire_6.text: Eight a day and eight the next day. The number does not fall. Nothing is being reduced.

venom_mire_7.speaker: Note weighted under a stone
venom_mire_7.text: Nettle: the reeds are the same age as the seal on the vault. Ask yourself what was poured out.

venom_mire_8.speaker: Cut into a drowned lintel
venom_mire_8.text: The mire has a middle and everything is walking toward it, including the water.

venom_mire_9.speaker: Reed-cutter's complaint
venom_mire_9.text: The harvest engines have not stopped since the Keeping. There has been no harvest since the Keeping.

venom_mire_10.speaker: Scrawled on a barrel stave
venom_mire_10.text: Overflow, sealed, do not breach. Breached. In another hand: it was going to breach anyway.

venom_mire_11.speaker: Prayer card, sunk and recovered
venom_mire_11.text: Let it be given back. Let it be given back entire. The reverse is blank, which is unusual for a prayer card.

venom_mire_12.speaker: Scratched at the waterline
venom_mire_12.text: Eleven years downhill. Everything the vaults let go arrived here and stayed.

venom_mire_reread.speaker: Scratched at the waterline
venom_mire_reread.text: Eleven years downhill. Everything the vaults let go arrived here and stayed.

frozen_fortress_1.speaker: Quartermaster's standing order
frozen_fortress_1.text: No fires. Cold keeps what warmth spends. The garrison was informed, and the garrison complied, and the garrison is still complying.

frozen_fortress_2.speaker: Ration returns
frozen_fortress_2.text: Two winters of returns in the same hand, all identical. The hand does not change in the third winter either.

frozen_fortress_3.speaker: Oath cut into the north wall
frozen_fortress_3.text: Bare palm to cold iron: to hold what was given until it is asked for. Nobody ever came to ask.

frozen_fortress_4.speaker: Undelivered dispatch
frozen_fortress_4.text: We have preserved it perfectly. Tell the Chapter it is perfect. Tell them to come and take it. Tell them soon.

frozen_fortress_5.speaker: Standing order, posted
frozen_fortress_5.text: The fortress will hold through the winter. There is no order for the winter after this one.

frozen_fortress_6.speaker: Ration book
frozen_fortress_6.text: Three arrows a day. Two meals. One lamp between eight. Struck through: one lamp between sixteen.

frozen_fortress_7.speaker: Cut into the parapet
frozen_fortress_7.text: The cold came the same week the light went. We were told these were unrelated.

frozen_fortress_8.speaker: Officer's private note
frozen_fortress_8.text: I have admitted the raiders. I have not put it to a vote. There will not be a vote.

frozen_fortress_9.speaker: Chalked in the muster hall
frozen_fortress_9.text: Names in this column are on the wall. Names in this column are under it.

frozen_fortress_10.speaker: Note left in a quiver
frozen_fortress_10.text: Whoever picks this up: the wall is not the problem. The wall has never once been the problem.

frozen_fortress_11.speaker: Scratched inside a helm
frozen_fortress_11.text: Nine hundred nights and the sun has not been the argument. Somebody took it and filed the paperwork.

frozen_fortress_12.speaker: Last page of the watch book
frozen_fortress_12.text: Relieved of the watch. By whom is not stated. The handwriting stops mid-word.

frozen_fortress_reread.speaker: Last page of the watch book
frozen_fortress_reread.text: Relieved of the watch. By whom is not stated. The handwriting stops mid-word.

glacial_hollow_1.speaker: Posting on the drift
glacial_hollow_1.text: The drift took the outer works in one night. The order to hold was posted the next morning, over the top of the drift.

glacial_hollow_2.speaker: Pilgrim's mark
glacial_hollow_2.text: Cut into the ice, redone each season by a different hand, always the same three words: STILL BEING KEPT.

glacial_hollow_3.speaker: Keener's lament, transcribed
glacial_hollow_3.text: Eleven verses by someone who did not speak the language. The eleventh verse is a list of names.

glacial_hollow_4.speaker: Found in a cairn
glacial_hollow_4.text: A lamp, unlit, wrapped in three coats. Whoever wrapped it had two.

glacial_hollow_5.speaker: Cairn tag
glacial_hollow_5.text: Marker set for the bearers to find on the way back up. Set eleven times. Moved once, by something.

glacial_hollow_6.speaker: Anchorite's rule, cut into a cell wall
glacial_hollow_6.text: I am sealed in at my own request. Do not unseal me. The request stands.

glacial_hollow_7.speaker: Pilgrim's note, frozen to a post
glacial_hollow_7.text: Walking to the light. If found, the light was further than stated.

glacial_hollow_8.speaker: Bearer's ledger
glacial_hollow_8.text: Empty measures carried up: two hundred. Full measures carried down: none. This is the wrong way round.

glacial_hollow_9.speaker: Scratched on a stair
glacial_hollow_9.text: The Warden watches this stair. The Warden has always watched this stair. Nothing has ever come up it.

glacial_hollow_10.speaker: Keening rota
glacial_hollow_10.text: Mourners to attend in pairs. Struck through. Mourners to attend alone. Struck through. Mourners to attend.

glacial_hollow_11.speaker: Carved beside a sealed door
glacial_hollow_11.text: They kept the practice after they ran out of dead. Then they were the dead and kept it anyway.

glacial_hollow_12.speaker: A single line, deep in the ice
glacial_hollow_12.text: The hollow is not empty. The hollow is what is left after something was taken out cleanly.

glacial_hollow_reread.speaker: A single line, deep in the ice
glacial_hollow_reread.text: The hollow is not empty. The hollow is what is left after something was taken out cleanly.

dark_cathedral_1.speaker: Amended order of service
dark_cathedral_1.text: The line that asked for morning has been struck out. The amendment is in the Hierarch's hand, and it is a very steady hand.

dark_cathedral_2.speaker: Lector's marginalia
dark_cathedral_2.text: I have read the same page aloud for thirty years. It has not once read me back.

dark_cathedral_3.speaker: Confession, folded small
dark_cathedral_3.text: I signed for the measures. I did not know they were counted in people. I knew by the second year. I signed for six more.

dark_cathedral_4.speaker: Above the altar
dark_cathedral_4.text: Where a sun was, a socket. Cleaned. Sized for something that was taken away carefully, rather than stolen.

dark_cathedral_5.speaker: Order of service
dark_cathedral_5.text: For the Return of the Light. Printed in a quantity of four hundred. None appear to have been used.

dark_cathedral_6.speaker: Note in the sacristy
dark_cathedral_6.text: The vestments are for an office with no holder. Keep them aired. Somebody may yet hold it.

dark_cathedral_7.speaker: Bell-ringer's log
dark_cathedral_7.text: Rung to call the Chapter up. Rung again. Rung again. Rung until the rope parted.

dark_cathedral_8.speaker: Cut into a pew back
dark_cathedral_8.text: Kneel here for the eleven. The eleven are not named because naming them was made an offence.

dark_cathedral_9.speaker: Warden's key tag
dark_cathedral_9.text: Keys handed to the laity. Reason: the clergy have gone below and have not set a date.

dark_cathedral_10.speaker: Torn from a hymnal
dark_cathedral_10.text: The verse about restoring is missing from every copy in the building. It was cut, not lost.

dark_cathedral_11.speaker: Confessor's slate, wiped and rewritten
dark_cathedral_11.text: Heard, not recorded. Heard, not recorded. Heard, not recorded.

dark_cathedral_12.speaker: Chalked behind the altar
dark_cathedral_12.text: We prayed toward the sky for nine years. The shaft is the other way.

dark_cathedral_reread.speaker: Chalked behind the altar
dark_cathedral_reread.text: We prayed toward the sky for nine years. The shaft is the other way.

umbral_chapel_1.speaker: The chapel keeps no hours
umbral_chapel_1.text: Between the last bell and the first, nothing is permitted to happen. The Hierarch works in that gap, and the gap is where everything happened.

umbral_chapel_2.speaker: Penitent's ledger-page
umbral_chapel_2.text: What I owe, in measures. What is owed to me: the same column, crossed through.

umbral_chapel_3.speaker: The Hierarch's note
umbral_chapel_3.text: The account will balance. It has always been a matter of finding the last entry.

umbral_chapel_4.speaker: Cut into the doorframe by someone leaving
umbral_chapel_4.text: THE LIGHT WAS NEVER STORED. IT WAS SPENT. WE ARE THE RECEIPT.

umbral_chapel_5.speaker: Reliquary label
umbral_chapel_5.text: Contents: one measure of daylight, sealed. Later hand: was.

umbral_chapel_6.speaker: Penitent's term
umbral_chapel_6.text: Sentence: a term of years, to be served kneeling. The term has run. The sentence has not been lifted.

umbral_chapel_7.speaker: Struck from every copy
umbral_chapel_7.text: The name of the Hierarch is to be struck from every copy. The strokes are all in one hand and it is his.

umbral_chapel_8.speaker: Censer chain tag
umbral_chapel_8.text: The smoke carries the prayer upward. Note beneath: the shaft goes down. Nobody corrected the rite.

umbral_chapel_9.speaker: Cowl inventory
umbral_chapel_9.text: Issued to the inner orders so the outer orders need not recognise them afterwards. Afterwards is doing a great deal of work.

umbral_chapel_10.speaker: Scratched at the altar socket
umbral_chapel_10.text: Something was set here and taken. The socket is warm and has been warm for eleven years.

umbral_chapel_11.speaker: A page of the account, recovered
umbral_chapel_11.text: Spent: all of it. Recovered: none of it. Returned to the town: the dead, relit, at cost.

umbral_chapel_12.speaker: Last line, cut deep and unsigned
umbral_chapel_12.text: The account balances when there is nobody left to be owed.

umbral_chapel_reread.speaker: Last line, cut deep and unsigned
umbral_chapel_reread.text: The account balances when there is nobody left to be owed.

closing.speaker: Wall inscription
closing.text: They swore to hold the gate until the kingdom returned. Nobody wrote down what the kingdom was supposed to return from.
